test.run: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq flex bison >/dev/null && curl -fsSL https://dl.mercurylang.org/release/mercury-srcdist-22.01.8.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp && cd /tmp/mercury-srcdist-22.01.8 && ./configure --prefix=/opt/mercury --with-default-grade=hlc.gc --enable-libgrades=hlc.gc >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -j$(nproc) PARALLEL=-j$(nproc) >/dev/null 2>&1 && make install PARALLEL=-j$(nproc) >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd /src && export PATH=/opt/mercury/bin:$PATH && mmc --make helloworld && ./helloworld
